## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): tone content, both signs

Raw → tone-tracked onset (`sdh_onset`) → FFT in 1/B (`sdh_fft`, deg-5 poly-in-B background, two cuts for stability) for run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) and run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T). Overlay: `fs_count_b0` (the investigation's forward model).

**Read (run 6, electron — the informative side):** clean tone set {7.1, 22.1, 29.5} T with 14.1 T weak (= 2×7.1 harmonic). Two hypotheses at one density: (a) ABAB pair — 7.1 (light) + 22.1 (heavy), sum 29.2 ≈ measured 29.5 = symmetry-allowed breakdown/sum tone at F_L; global density scale 29.2/33.1 = 0.88 (inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm prior), partition 0.24/0.76 vs model 0.22/0.78 at this n; or (b) 22.1 = 3×7.1 (= 21.3, within that tone's δF 1.6 T) and 29.5 = 4×7.1 harmonics of a single 7.1 T pocket — which fails Luttinger catastrophically (scale 0.21) unless the layer/degeneracy assumptions are wrong. **One density cannot separate (a) from (b)** — the investigation's harmonic screen is exactly the n-dependence: a harmonic tracks 3·f₁(n); a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (model: heavy/light ratio runs 4.8 → 3.5 over n = 2.0 → 3.2×10¹²). That is the fan's job.

**Read (run 7, hole):** the predicted near-CNP balanced-pair mess — many overlapping tones (4.7/6.6/8.5/9.4/12.3 T), δF only 0.8–1.5 T, F_L = 12.4 T. Consistent with the recipe's low-|n| exception regime; uninformative for the call, as priced in the proposal. **Fan side: electron.**

**Onset caveat → next step:** run 6's carrying tone is `censored` at the tool's low edge (0.30 T), and the record below 1 T is the 50 mT coarse leg, which undersamples the 7.1 T tone below ~0.85 T (aliases, not a measured onset). Per `landau-fan` step 1: a censored carrying tone gets a **cheap low-field extension** to pin B_lo before the fan — landed next (~25 min). LK expectation at T_e ≈ 8 K: light m* ≈ 0.027 → thermal factor ~0.1 at 0.7 T, ~0.02 at 0.5 T, so the measured onset likely sits 0.7–1.0 T; every 0.1 T of unneeded B_lo costs ~10 fan rows.

"""Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): raw -> onset -> FFT vs F_L.
Run 6: electron, n = +3.2e12 (Vtg +0.9836, Vbg +1.1661), B 0->10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above).
Run 7: hole, n = -1.2e12 (Vtg -0.2770, Vbg -0.4650), B 10->0.3 T, 20 mT (ride-down)."""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft

I_BIAS = 10e-9
RFS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS                                  # 5 kOhm full scale (sr1 gain 1)
H4E = 6.62607015e-34 / (4 * 1.602176634e-19)          # h/4e, T m^2

spots = {6: +3.2e16, 7: -1.2e16}                      # m^-2
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 7.5))
onsets = {}
for i, (fid, n) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = open_run(f"data/{fid}")
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = H4E * abs(n)

    # raw FIRST
    ax = axes[i, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)",
           title=f"run {fid} raw — n = {n/1e16:+.1f}e12, D = 0")

    # onset (tone-tracked; r_full_scale guards soft clip)
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=RFS)
    onsets[fid] = on
    print(f"===== run {fid}: n = {n/1e16:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T =====")
    print(on.summary())

    # background-subtracted (poly deg 5 in B) over the usable record
    cut = max(on.onset_b, 0.8)
    m = B >= cut
    p = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5)
    ax = axes[i, 1]
    ax.plot(B[m], R[m] - np.polyval(p, B[m]), lw=0.6)
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"$\Delta R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)",
           title=f"run {fid} bg-subtracted (deg 5, cut {cut:.2f} T)")

    # FFT in 1/B, two cuts (stability)
    ax = axes[i, 2]
    for c in (cut, cut + 0.5):
        mm = B >= c
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[mm][:, None], B[mm], b_range=(c, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
        ax.plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"cut {c:.2f} T")
    ax.axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", label=f"$F_L$ = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 1.6 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)",
           title=f"run {fid} FFT in 1/B")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    dF = 1 / (1 / cut - 1 / B.max())
    print(f"record above {cut:.2f} T -> dF = {dF:.2f} T\n")

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# model comparison at the electron spot (fs_count_b0, brief-designated arc-reader)
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs, abca_fs
_, orbs = abab_fs(3.2e16)
_, _, _, _, f_abca = abca_fs(3.2e16)
fl = H4E * 3.2e16
print(f"model @ n=+3.2e12: ABAB pair {orbs[0][0]:.1f} / {orbs[1][0]:.1f} T (partition "
      f"{orbs[0][0]/fl:.2f}/{orbs[1][0]/fl:.2f}); ABCA singleton {f_abca:.1f} T; F_L {fl:.1f} T")
print(f"measured run 6 (cut 0.80): tones 7.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T; 7.1+22.1 = 29.2 = {29.2/fl:.2f} F_L "
      f"(scale prior 0.8-1.2 OK); partition 7.1/29.2 = {7.1/29.2:.2f}, 22.1/29.2 = {22.1/29.2:.2f}")

## HERA — low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0.3 → 1.3 T

> **05:28** · sdh-spot-check low-B onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.3->1.3 T (5 mT <0.6, 10 mT above), sr1 5 uV, delay 0; pins fan B\_lo; ends at 1.3 T · **ETA ~05:53** (≈25 min)

Precondition to the Landau fan (`landau-fan` step 1, lever 1): run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is **censored at the record's low edge** — the sub-1 T leg was 50 mT-coarse, which undersamples the 7.1 T tone below ~0.85 T, so run 6 never measured the onset, and `B_lo` is the fan's most expensive lever (every 0.1 T of unneeded B_lo ≈ 10 rows ≈ 30 min of fan). This cell re-measures 0.3 → 1.3 T at the same (n, D) spot on a Nyquist-clean grid: 5 mT below 0.6 T, 10 mT above (matches run 6's fine leg for splicing; a grid-change reproduction check on the sub-1 T tone tracks for free). Sensitivity dropped to 5 µV (500 Ω FS): run 6's record below 1.3 T stayed ≤ 57 Ω, and an onset hunt needs ~15 mΩ ADC resolution, not the fan's 10 T headroom. LK prior at T_e ≈ 8 K (light m* ≈ 0.027 mₑ): thermal factor ~0.1 at 0.7 T, ~0.02 at 0.5 T — expect onset 0.7–1.0 T; the measured number, not this prior, sets the fan's B_lo. Ends at 1.3 T with gates at the spot — the fan starts adjacent, no re-traverse. Checkpoint: first ~20 rows (rail/sensitivity — 500 Ω FS is 8.8× over run 6's local max but is a new setting; leakage; T). Price: 131 pts × (5–10 mT ramp + 3 s settle + reads) ≈ 15 min + 0→0.3 T ramp 2 min ≈ 18 min.

# === Low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.3 -> 1.3 T fine grid ===
# Pins the fan's B_lo: run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is censored at the record edge and its
# sub-1 T leg (50 mT) undersamples 7.1 T below ~0.85 T (Nyquist dB <= 0.07*B^2). Grid here:
# 5 mT below 0.6 T (Nyquist at 0.3 T needs <= 6.3 mT), 10 mT above (matches run 6's fine leg).
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)  # run 5
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (== run 6)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left field at 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.3, 0.6, 0.005), np.arange(0.6, 1.3001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Sensitivity sized to the local record, not the 10 T excursion: run 6 below 1.3 T stayed <= 57 Ohm
# (med 6-16). 5 uV = 500 Ohm FS at 10 nA -> 8.8x headroom, ADC step ~15 mOhm (near-onset dR is sub-Ohm;
# at run 6's 50 uV it was ~150 mOhm/count — too coarse for an onset hunt).
sr1.sensitivity(5e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (5 mT < 0.6 T, 10 mT above); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (500 Ohm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.3 T (5/10 mT), sr1 5 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0; '
              f'B 0.3 -> 1.3 T, 5 mT below 0.6 T / 10 mT above (7.1 T tone Nyquist); pins landau-fan B_lo')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# ends at 1.3 T, gates at the spot — the fan starts near here (B_lo from this record), no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
